briefdescription.para: Maximum baud rate error percentage allowed.

detaileddescription.para: The following constant defines the amount of error allowed for a specified baud rate. This error is the difference between the actual baud rate generated using the specified clock and the desired baud rate.

briefdescription.para: Provides a default stub handler for interrupt callbacks.

briefdescription.para: Initializes a specific XUartPsv instance for use.

detaileddescription.para: The data format of the device is setup for 8 data bits, 1 stop bit, and no parity by default. The baud rate is set to a default value specified by Config->DefaultBaudRate if set, otherwise it is set to 19.2K baud. The receive FIFO threshold is set for 8 bytes. The default operating mode of the driver is polled mode.

parameterdescription.para: Reference to a structure containing information about a specific XUartPsv driver.

Device base address in the virtual memory address space. The caller is responsible for keeping the address mapping from EffectiveAddr to the device physical base address unchanged once this function is invoked. Unexpected errors may occur if the address mapping changes after this function is called. If address translation is not used, pass in the physical address instead.

briefdescription.para: Sends the specified buffer in polled or interrupt driven mode.

detaileddescription.para: This function is non-blocking. If the device is busy sending data, it returns and indicates zero bytes were sent. Otherwise, it fills the TX FIFO as much as it can, and returns the number of bytes sent.
In polled mode, this function only sends as much data as the TX FIFO can buffer. The application may need to call it repeatedly to send the entire buffer.

In interrupt mode, this function starts sending the specified buffer, then the interrupt handler continues sending data until the entire buffer has been sent. A callback function, as specified by the application, is called to indicate the completion of sending.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to a buffer of data to send.
Number of bytes to send. A value of zero stops a previous send operation that is in progress in interrupt mode. Any data that was already put into the transmit FIFO is sent.

simplesect.para: The number of bytes actually sent.
The number of bytes is not asserted so that this function may be called with a value of zero to stop an operation that is already in progress.

briefdescription.para: Sends a buffer previously specified by setting up the instance variables of the instance.

detaileddescription.para: Implemented for RTOS environment as an internal function for the XUartPsv driver, called from XUartPsv_Send_NoWait which sets up the buffer.
Sends the specified buffer in polled mode. Only sends as much data as the TX FIFO can buffer. The application may need to call it repeatedly to send the entire buffer.

simplesect.para: The number of bytes actually sent.

briefdescription.para: Sends the specified buffer in polled mode without waiting.

detaileddescription.para: This function is non-blocking. If the device is busy sending data, it returns and indicates zero bytes were sent. Otherwise, it fills the TX FIFO as much as it can, and returns the number of bytes sent. The application may need to call it repeatedly to send the entire buffer.
Implemented for RTOS environment. It checks status and returns without waiting. The caller of XUartPsv_Send_NoWait can wait based on the return value.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to a buffer of data to send.
Number of bytes to send. A value of zero stops a previous send operation that is in progress in interrupt mode. Any data that was already put into the transmit FIFO is sent.

listitem.para: The number of bytes actually sent, if data successfully sent.
0, if TX is busy. The caller of XUartPsv_Send_NoWait can wait if return is 0.

simplesect.para: The number of bytes is not asserted so that this function may be called with a value of zero to stop an operation that is already in progress.

briefdescription.para: Attempts to receive a specified number of bytes of data from the device and store it into the specified buffer.

detaileddescription.para: Works for both polled and interrupt driven modes. It is non-blocking.

In polled mode, this function only receives the data already in the RX FIFO. The application may need to call it repeatedly to receive the entire buffer. Polled mode is the default mode of operation for the device.

In interrupt mode, this function starts the receiving. If not the entire buffer has been received, the interrupt handler continues receiving data until the entire buffer has been received. A callback function, as specified by the application, is called to indicate completion of the receiving or error conditions.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to buffer to receive data into.
Number of bytes to receive. A value of zero stops a previous receive operation that is in progress in interrupt mode.

simplesect.para: The number of bytes is not asserted so that this function may be called with a value of zero to stop an operation that is already in progress.

briefdescription.para: Sends a buffer previously specified by setting up the instance variables of the instance.

detaileddescription.para: This function sends the buffer in either polled or interrupt driven modes.
This is an internal function for the XUartPsv driver. It may be called from a shell function that sets up the buffer or from an interrupt handler. This function is non-blocking.
In polled mode, this function only sends as much data as the TX FIFO can buffer. The application may need to call it repeatedly to send the entire buffer.

In interrupt mode, this function starts the sending of the buffer. If not the entire buffer has been sent, then the interrupt handler continues the sending until the entire buffer has been sent. A callback function, as specified by the application, is called to indicate the completion of sending.

simplesect.para: The number of bytes actually sent.

briefdescription.para: Receives a buffer previously specified by setting up the instance variables of the instance.

detaileddescription.para: This is an internal function. It may be called from a shell function that sets up the buffer or from an interrupt handler.
Attempts to receive a specified number of bytes from the device and store them into the specified buffer. Works for either polled or interrupt driven modes. It is non-blocking.

In polled mode, this function only receives as much data as in the RX FIFO. The application may need to call it repeatedly to receive the entire buffer. Polled mode is the default mode for the driver.

In interrupt mode, this function starts the receiving. If not the entire buffer has been received, the interrupt handler continues until the entire buffer has been received. A callback function, as specified by the application, is called to indicate the completion of the receiving or error conditions.

briefdescription.para: Sets the baud rate for the device.

detaileddescription.para: Checks the input value for validity and also verifies that the requested rate can be configured to within the maximum error range specified by XUARTPSV_MAX_BAUD_ERROR_RATE. If the provided rate is not possible, the current setting is unchanged.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if everything configured as expected.
XST_UART_BAUD_ERROR if the requested rate is not available because there was too much error.
